collapse_rules.unique_pmids_merged: union of PMIDs across all drug_ids under the same drug_name for a given disease_id (within collected evidence)
collapse_rules.year_counts: derived from PubTator JSON evidence articles[].date, aggregated per (drug_name, disease_id)

string_keys.disease_key_tokens: token multiset with lightweight singularization, stored as JSON

notes: PMIDs per drug-disease are capped by the upstream collection; counts reflect collected evidence, not necessarily all PubMed.
